claim_boundaries: Owned deterministic schedules across two real SQLite connections; no external target or finding.
One coherent local snapshot may precede an overlapping writer; latest external-head authority remains unproved.
DELETE-mode readers can delay commits and yield ordinary typed contention; no availability or latency qualification.
Nested reads share the existing caller transaction and leave its commit/rollback authority intact.
Cleanup tests cover one escaping interruption or SQL rollback refusal under working connection close; repeated interruption, OS termination, device faults and power loss remain outside the proof.
Native-provider, external recovery, protected storage and execution gates remain open.
